## LmdbEnv.getMapSizeUsed() method

Return map usage — configured map size vs current on-disk size.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getMapSizeUsed(): IMapUsage;
```
**Returns:**

IMapUsage

## Remarks

Simple estimation via `statSync` on the data file: `used` is the file size, `ratio` is the free fraction of the configured map. When the file cannot be measured (e.g. closed/not yet created) `ratio` is `1`<!-- -->.
